notes:
v4.6.76 — Universe tab cleanup + broker scoping + sturdier bot generation

🌐 UNIVERSE TAB
• Removed the “run a universe script” control — universes are generated on the server now, not run by hand.
• The tab now shows the FULL catalogue of all ~34 public universes (sector, factor and crypto packs) with their tickers — not just your 4 bot universes.

🏦 BROKER SCOPING
• An Alpaca-only bot no longer appears in the IBKR allocation tab in any way (not in the table, not in the “add bot” list). Fixed the underlying bug where every custom bot was mis-tagged as Alpaca-only.

🤖 MAKE BOT
• Added a strict RUN-READY checklist to the generation instructions so new bots compile and run on the first try: always-valid decisions, safe position sizing, correct ticker format, no forbidden imports, fully-filled card info.

Update via the in-app banner.
